## What we adopt
Only the message thread (bubbles with name and time) and the input box from the right-hand pane of Tabler's chat page.

## What Ad Astra changes
Drop the left conversation list and search: a student has one thread with the teacher. Shown as a slide-out panel inside the workspace; broadcast answers appear highlighted.

Ad Astra branding (plan §1.1) always overrides template colours and logos.
